# Free QR Code & Barcode Generator - UniversalCodeMaker.com

> A free, privacy-first web app that generates static QR codes and barcodes in the browser: 10 barcode formats and 13 QR code types. No sign-up, no watermark, no tracking, and the codes never expire.

## Core Capabilities
- **QR Codes**: Standard QR Code with custom dot and corner styles, colours, gradients and a centred logo.
- **QR Code Types (13)**: Website link, Wi-Fi auto-connect (WPA/WPA2/WPA3, WEP, open, hidden network), vCard 3.0 contact, email, SMS, phone call, cryptocurrency payment (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, USDT), calendar event (iCalendar), map location, plain text, Google review link, WhatsApp chat, UPI payment (India).
- **Retail Barcodes**: EAN-13, UPC-A, ISBN-13 (books), with check digits calculated and verified.
- **Logistics & Industrial**: Code 128, Code 39, ITF-14.
- **2D Codes**: Data Matrix (ECC 200), Aztec Code, PDF417.
- **Barcode & QR Scanner**: Reads QR, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417, EAN/UPC, Code 128, Code 39 and more from an uploaded image or the device camera, decoded locally in the browser (nothing uploaded).
- **Export Formats**: Vector SVG, PNG at 1x, 2x or 4x (300 DPI print), PDF label sheets (Avery 5160, 5163, L7160 and Amazon FBA/FNSKU labels), and batch ZIP download.

## Technical & Privacy Guarantee
- All barcode encoding and rendering occurs 100% client-side in the user's browser memory via JavaScript (`bwip-js` and `qr-code-styling`).
- No user inputs, URLs, passwords, generated images, or scanned images/camera frames are ever transmitted to or stored on our servers.
- Codes are true static symbols with direct data encoding and no proprietary redirect servers.
